lesson.title: A clean ledger proves nothing unless the watcher provably ran
lesson.source: soak baseline 2026-08-26 (talos): Olympos sentinel ledgers wrote zero lines during the V5 soak window at both homes while auto-arm certification reads 'zero cross-fleet incidents in either ledger'
lesson.lesson: Every 'zero incidents' claim over a time window must ride with positive liveness evidence - heartbeat entries, last-write timestamp freshness, or an explicit armed-watch assertion evaluated at window open. A ledger silent since before the window started means the instrument was down and its silence certifies nothing: mark it AMBER, arm the watch, and restart the clock rather than counting the dead interval as a clean pass. Absence of writer is absence of evidence.
